captions.zaku:
MS-06 ZAKU II · ザク

The Principality of Zeon's mass-production workhorse — more Zaku IIs fought in the One Year War (U.C. 0079) than any other mobile suit. The single mono-eye and shoulder spike became the silhouette of a war. Char Aznable's crimson command type earned him the name 'Red Comet.'

Rebuilt as one continuous line and drawn in pigment ink by an AxiDraw. Nothing printed — every impression is drawn.

ED. 09/25 · 11×14″
captions.dom:
MS-09 DOM · ドム

A Zeon ground-assault suit that skated across open terrain on thermonuclear hover jets — deceptively fast for its bulk. Armed with a scattering beam gun and a giant heat saber. Its Rick Dom cousins armed the Black Tri-Stars' feared Jet Stream Attack.

Redrawn as a single continuous line, drawn by machine in ink on Strathmore Bristol.

ED. 12/25 · 11×14″
captions.guncannon:
RX-77 GUNCANNON · ガンキャノン

Earth Federation mid-range fire support, born from Project V alongside the RX-78-2 Gundam. Twin shoulder cannons and heavy torso armor traded mobility for standoff firepower aboard White Base.

One unbroken path, traced line by line in pigment ink by a pen plotter.

ED. 18/25 · 11×14″
captions.bigzam:
MA-08 BIG ZAM · ビグ・ザム

A colossal Zeon mobile armor built to hold off an entire fleet alone — its I-field turned aside beam weapons. Dozle Zabi took it into the defense of Solomon in the closing days of the One Year War. 'If only we'd had the resources to mass-produce it…'

Rebuilt as one continuous line and plotted in ink, stroke by stroke.

ED. 05/25 · 11×14″
captions.zgok:
MSM-07 Z'GOK · ズゴック

Zeon's amphibious raider — surfacing from the sea for hit-and-run strikes. Rounded armor, iron-nail claws, and head-mounted mega particle guns. Char Aznable fielded a custom command type in his signature red.

A single continuous path, traced in pigment ink on archival paper by an AxiDraw.

ED. 22/25 · 11×14″
captions.gp02:
RX-78GP02A PHYSALIS · ガンダム試作2号機

A Gundam Development Project prototype engineered around a single, terrible purpose: to carry and fire an atomic warhead. Heavy shielding and a plasma-clad shield define its silhouette. In U.C. 0083 it was stolen by Anavel Gato — the 'Nightmare of Solomon.'

One continuous line, drawn by machine in pigment ink.

ED. 15/25 · 11×14″
